name: Design Cart 3D Carousel
author: Paweł Nosko

sections.description:
Design Cart 3D Carousel lets you manage multiple 3D carousels in the WordPress admin and place them on any page or post with a shortcode:

[dc_3d_carousel id="123"]

Author: Paweł Nosko

Project page: Design Cart 3D Carousel – when a regular image gallery is not enough

Images are stored in a dedicated uploads folder. Settings match the createCarousel engine options (layers, camera, mist, autoplay, and more).
sections.installation:
1. Upload the design-cart-3d-carousel folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  3. Open 3D Carousel in the admin menu to create a carousel.
sections.faq:
How do I display a carousel?

Use the shortcode [dc_3d_carousel id="ID"] and replace ID with the carousel ID from the plugin list.

Where are images stored?

In wp-content/uploads/design-cart-3d-carousel/{carousel-id}/.
